viewing_check: Check the wood (oak vs chestnut/pine), whether the carving is original or later, interior lining, hinges and hasp for age, old repairs, replaced lid or base, woodworm. Photograph the underside, dovetails and any lock or key. Genuine 18th century with age would be worth more than a later Spanish revival piece.
